scope: One original fixed 256k SH0 workload and intended orbit trace; construction is not observed performance or supported capacity

origin.authorship: Original analytic construction authored for SplatView Web

formatReference.name: PlayCanvas splat-transform
formatReference.purpose: 32-byte .splat layout reference only; no copied generated fixture or implementation

workload.sizePolicy: Fixed workload; no configurable count or supported capacity inference
workload.spatialDistribution: 64 x 50 x 80 dyadic grid with records 0, 1 and 2 replaced by three isolated off-grid anchors
workload.overdrawIntent: Small nonzero Gaussian footprints; projected overlap is unmeasured and must be recorded at actual replay checkpoints

units.color: unorm8 RGB before SH DC conversion
units.angles: camera yaw/pitch/roll radians; vertical field of view degrees

wire.sourceId: Zero-based record ordinal; all 256000 records retained in source order

layout.meaning: RGBA; opaque primary R,G,B repeating by sourceId modulo 3

positionRule.uniqueness: Grid positions are unique; every anchor is outside the grid bounds

canonicalScene.sourceOrder: Ascending source ID 0 through 255999; no sorting or sampling
canonicalScene.signedZeroPolicy: Normalize every float32 and binary16 numeric zero to positive zero for semantic identity hashes

layout.meaning: covariance yz,zz and two reserved padding values
coefficient-major RGB SH; first three values DC; remaining 45 positive zero

canonicalScene.sourceOrderSerialization: Concatenated uint32 little-endian source IDs 0 through 255999, no prefix or delimiter
canonicalScene.fullMembershipSerialization: Same uint32 little-endian sequence as source order; all original records, no selected or deleted records

hashRules.fullMembershipSha256: Full-membership serialization bytes; explicitly aliases sourceOrderSha256 for this full workload
hashRules.expectedSceneSha256: Concatenated canonical 144-byte records in source order, no prefix
hashRules.distributionSha256: UTF-8 domain prefix followed by the same canonical record bytes
hashRules.traceSha256: UTF-8 JSON.stringify(trace, null, 2) followed by one LF
hashRules.projectionSha256: UTF-8 JSON.stringify({ framebuffer: trace.framebuffer, projection: trace.projection }, null, 2) followed by one LF; object key order exactly as shown

trace.replay: Set each phase's first absolute camera state before starting its clock. Warmup and measured orbit each make one full positive-yaw revolution; sample yaw = 2 * Math.PI * (sampleIndex / intervalCount), using that operation order and JavaScript binary64. Interpolate yaw linearly between samples, hold all other camera components fixed. Hide viewport for final 1000 ms and perform no camera action there.
trace.resetPolicy: Fresh full fixture and fixed camera before each scenario; no inherited selection, deletion, edit history or view revision
trace.cachePolicy: Collector must separately observe cold cache invalidation and warm cache reuse; trace labels alone do not prove either

selectionQualification.reason: Precise production contributor, query and amendment parameters and their independent masks are not yet qualified; the three anchor records do not establish GPU picking correctness
worklist: Bind fixed camera, actual projection bytes, framebuffer, contributor options and baseline masks for each pick/query/amendment case
Independently establish source-membership masks and parameter identities before timing
Observe cold invalidation and warm cache reuse for 30 attempts per condition and operation; retain failed attempts
Collect actual projected-overdraw checkpoints throughout the declared orbit

exportCase.membership: All source IDs, source order; fullMembershipSha256
exportCase.precisionPolicy: ply-splat-numeric-v1; independent parsed attributes and membership/order, never count-only proof or byte-identical re-encoding assumption

fixtureSpecificInvariants.positionAndSourceOrder: Exact original positions and source IDs in original order
fixtureSpecificInvariants.sortedLinearScale: Each independently parsed sorted linear scale must differ from its sorted original scale by at most 4e-6 times that original scale
fixtureSpecificInvariants.primaryRGBA: Every source ID retains its exact opaque primary RGBA bytes, including alpha 255
fixtureSpecificInvariants.basis: Bounds supplement the frozen ply-splat-numeric-v1 covariance/quaternion policy for this fixture; they do not replace it or establish bounds for other inputs

exportCase.note: Actual exported byte SHA must be retained with independently parsed numeric error maxima and worst record; original input SHA is not an export oracle

qualification.independentOracle: tools/bench/oracles.ts; must not import this generator or production parser/math
qualification.pinning: Root independently verifies prepared fixture and canonical identities, then pins status and hashes before default construction

pinEvidence.identity: Codex automated byte/oracle consistency attribution; no human approval or performance acceptance
pinEvidence.traceReview: All 142 absolute camera samples, phase clocks, framebuffer and hidden action reviewed independently against declared procedure. No browser actions were observed.
